_notes: Every material any hammer piece costs (piece_costs.json, read from the game 2026-10-05), by the boss kill that opens it. A stage's materials are the ones it adds; 'before moder' means the stages up to and including bonemass.

A material is placed where a group normally first gets it: by the tool or key the boss gives (antler pickaxe, swamp key, wishbone, dragon tear, wisplight) or the biome that follows that boss. Traders (Haldor, Hildir) count from the start.
This game has Deep North content (moose, seals, writhan, frostwood, gold, ice, snowballs): it comes after Fader.
Not certain, placed by their description and the pieces that use them: GlowWorm, NornThread, Pot_Shard_Green, CharcoalResin, Ruby, SilverNecklace, Snowball.
python blueprint.py cost <name> shows each material's stage; --before <boss> lists the pieces that need that boss or later.

stages.opens: Meadows and Black Forest with stone and flint tools, burial chambers, the traders
Hard antler: the antler pickaxe mines copper and tin, so bronze; the bronze axe fells birch and oak (fine wood); the cultivator
Swamp key: sunken crypts and their iron; the Swamp
Wishbone: silver in the Mountains; wolves, obsidian, crystal
Dragon tear: the artisan table (spinning wheel, blast furnace); the Plains
Torn spirit: the wisplight; the Mistlands
